programs.title: Love Nature
programs.desc: Charity Birmingham Tree People, especially dedicated to adding trees to areas with higher deprivation, work with the community to plant six new cherry trees in Handsworth Park.

programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan takes in wonders of Worcestershire, The Malverns and Midlands. From speed records to time travel, she explores history, speed, luxury, canals - and the world's smallest theatre.

programs.title: Cheshire: Britain's Most Scenic Counties
programs.desc: We meet a sheepdog handler husband-and-wife team as they enter sheepdog trials. And a world-renowned glass artist creates a new wall sculpture for a restaurant.

programs.title: Reuben Owen: Life in The Dales
programs.desc: As late summer arrives, Reuben and the gang juggle work, adventures and drama with the installation of underground pipework at a country house and a trip to Ireland.

programs.title: 999: Critical Condition
programs.desc: On the front line at Birmingham's Queen Elizabeth Hospital. A man falls from scaffold, impaling himself on a flagpole, and a 73-year-old faces life-changing injuries.

programs.title: HMP Frankland: Evil Behind Bars
programs.desc: An insight in to HMP Frankland, a men's maximum security prison. It's prisoners have committed the worst offences of all, including inmates Peter Sutcliffe and Ian Huntley.
